value.text:
Apayao State College (ASC) is a public higher education college in Apayao, in the Philippines. Its main campus is in Conner, and it also has a satellite campus in Luna. The institution has previously been known as Conner Vocational High School, Kalinga-Apayao School of Arts and Trades, and Apayao Institute of Science and Technology.

Its listed undergraduate programmes include secondary and elementary education, information technology, industrial technology, civil engineering, agriculture, business administration, tourism, criminology and forestry. Other listed bachelor’s programmes cover physical education and agricultural biosystems engineering. Graduate provision includes a doctorate in education with a major in educational leadership and management. Master’s programmes encompass education, public administration and science, with listed specialisations including educational management, English, mathematics, programme development and administration, animal science and crop science.
